name: Single
use: Use for one value from five or more options.
notUse: Not for ChoiceList radio for two to four outcomes.

name: Multi
use: Use for several values from a flat or sectioned catalogue.
notUse: Not for cascade-multi for a tree.

name: Cascade
use: Use for one leaf from a tree, such as medicine category → medicine.
notUse: Not for single for a flat list.

name: Cascade multi
use: Use for several leaves across kinds and groups, such as conditions.
notUse: Not for multi for a flat list.
